title: Thirty-Six Stratagems 2: He Is My Person

series.title: Thirty-Six Stratagems 2: He Is My Person

fullText.simplified:
五、后记

    围魏救赵是三十六计的第二计。中国有个老故事，魏国攻打赵国，赵国打不过魏国，就请另一个国家齐国来帮忙。齐国为了救赵国，就去攻打魏国的都城。魏国没办法，只好让攻打赵国的人都停下来，马上回来保护都城。就这样，齐国救了赵国，这就是围魏救赵的故事。上文故事中，金美美让小京撞警车，这是“围魏”。在救受伤的人和抓张学海这两件事里，警察只能救受伤的人，不能抓张学海，这是“救赵”。
    工作中，有时我们会遇到一些不好的事，不知道怎么做的时候，我们可以从事情的另一面想办法。现今，也有围魏救赵的事情。比如，A做了一些不好的事，电视台每天都在报道，大家都说A太坏了。突然有一天，电视台又报道，另一个人B也做了不好的事。大家看到这些报道，就说B太坏了。慢慢地，报道A的新闻没有了，大家都在看B的新闻，都说B是坏人。你可能已经想到了，B的坏新闻是A告诉给电视台的。没错，这就是A的“围魏救赵”。
fullText.traditional:
五、後記

    圍魏救趙是三十六計的第二計。中國有個老故事，魏國攻打趙國，趙國打不過魏國，就請另一個國家齊國來幫忙。齊國為了救趙國，就去攻打魏國的都城。魏國沒辦法，只好讓攻打趙國的人都停下來，馬上回來保護都城。就這樣，齊國救了趙國，這就是圍魏救趙的故事。上文故事中，金美美讓小京撞警車，這是“圍魏”。在救受傷的人和抓張學海這兩件事裡，警察只能救受傷的人，不能抓張學海，這是“救趙”。
    工作中，有時我們會遇到一些不好的事，不知道怎麼做的時候，我們可以從事情的另一面想辦法。現今，也有圍魏救趙的事情。比如，A做了一些不好的事，電視臺每天都在報道，大家都說A太壞了。突然有一天，電視臺又報道，另一個人B也做了不好的事。大家看到這些報道，就說B太壞了。慢慢地，報道A的新聞沒有了，大家都在看B的新聞，都說B是壞人。你可能已經想到了，B的壞新聞是A告訴給電視臺的。沒錯，這就是A的“圍魏救趙”。

sentences.simplified: 围魏救赵是三十六计的第二计。
sentences.traditional: 圍魏救趙是三十六計的第二計。
sentences.pinyin: wéi wèi jiù zhào shì sān shí liù jì de dì èr jì
sentences.english: “Besiege Wei to save Zhao” is the second of the Thirty-Six Stratagems.

sentences.simplified: 中国有个老故事，魏国攻打赵国，
sentences.traditional: 中國有個老故事，魏國攻打趙國，
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó yǒu ge lǎo gù shi wèi guó gōng dǎ zhào guó
sentences.english: There’s an old story in China where the state of Wei attacked the state of Zhao.

sentences.simplified: 赵国打不过魏国，就请另一个国家齐国来帮忙。
sentences.traditional: 趙國打不過魏國，就請另一個國家齊國來幫忙。
sentences.pinyin: zhào guó dǎ bu guò wèi guó jiù qǐng lìng yī ge guó jiā qí guó lái bāng máng
sentences.english: Since Zhao couldn’t defeat Wei, they asked another state, Qi, for help.

sentences.simplified: 齐国为了救赵国，就去攻打魏国的都城。
sentences.traditional: 齊國為了救趙國，就去攻打魏國的都城。
sentences.pinyin: qí guó wèi le jiù zhào guó jiù qù gōng dǎ wèi guó de dū chéng
sentences.english: To save the state of Zhao, the state of Qi attacked the capital of the state of Wei.

sentences.simplified: 魏国没办法，只好让攻打赵国的人都停下来，马上回来保护都城。
sentences.traditional: 魏國沒辦法，只好讓攻打趙國的人都停下來，馬上回來保護都城。
sentences.pinyin: wèi guó méi bàn fǎ zhǐ hǎo ràng gōng dǎ zhào guó de rén dōu tíng xià lai mǎ shàng huí lái bǎo hù dū chéng
sentences.english: Wei had no choice but to order the troops attacking Zhao to stop and immediately return to protect the capital.

sentences.simplified: 就这样，齐国救了赵国，这就是围魏救赵的故事。
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，齊國救了趙國，這就是圍魏救趙的故事。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng qí guó jiù le zhào guó zhè jiù shì wéi wèi jiù zhào de gù shi
sentences.english: In this way, the state of Qi saved the state of Zhao. This is the story of “besieging Wei to save Zhao”.

sentences.simplified: 上文故事中，金美美让小京撞警车，这是“围魏”。
sentences.traditional: 上文故事中，金美美讓小京撞警車，這是“圍魏”。
sentences.pinyin: shàng wén gù shi zhōng jīn měi měi ràng xiǎo jīng zhuàng jǐng chē zhè shì wéi wèi
sentences.english: In this story, Jin Meimei caused Little Jing to crash into the police car. This was “besieging Wei”.

sentences.simplified: 在救受伤的人和抓张学海这两件事里，警察只能救受伤的人，
sentences.traditional: 在救受傷的人和抓張學海這兩件事裡，警察只能救受傷的人，
sentences.pinyin: zài jiù shòu shāng de rén hé zhuā zhāng xué hǎi zhè liǎng jiàn shì lǐ jǐng chá zhǐ néng jiù shòu shāng de rén
sentences.english: Between saving the injured person and arresting Zhang Xuehai, the police could only save the injured person.

sentences.simplified: 不能抓张学海，这是“救赵”。
sentences.traditional: 不能抓張學海，這是“救趙”。
sentences.pinyin: bù néng zhuā zhāng xué hǎi zhè shì jiù zhào
sentences.english: They couldn’t arrest Zhang Xuehai. This was “saving Zhao”.

sentences.simplified: 工作中，有时我们会遇到一些不好的事，
sentences.traditional: 工作中，有時我們會遇到一些不好的事，
sentences.pinyin: gōng zuò zhōng yǒu shí wǒ men huì yù dào yì xiē bù hǎo de shì
sentences.english: In our work, sometimes we encounter some bad situations.

sentences.simplified: 不知道怎么做的时候，我们可以从事情的另一面想办法。
sentences.traditional: 不知道怎麼做的時候，我們可以從事情的另一面想辦法。
sentences.pinyin: bù zhī dào zěn me zuò de shí hou wǒ men kě yǐ cóng shì qing de lìng yí miàn xiǎng bàn fǎ
sentences.english: When we don’t know what to do, we can try to approach the problem from another perspective.

sentences.simplified: 现今，也有围魏救赵的事情。
sentences.traditional: 現今，也有圍魏救趙的事情。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn jīn yě yǒu wéi wèi jiù zhào de shì qing
sentences.english: Today, there are also “besieging Wei to save Zhao” situations.

sentences.simplified: 比如，A做了一些不好的事，电视台每天都在报道，大家都说A太坏了。
sentences.traditional: 比如，A做了一些不好的事，電視臺每天都在報道，大家都說A太壞了。
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú a zuò le yì xiē bù hǎo de shì diàn shì tái měi tiān dōu zài bào dào dà jiā dōu shuō a tài huài le
sentences.english: For example, if A does some bad things and the television station reports on it every day, everyone will say that A is really terrible.

sentences.simplified: 突然有一天，电视台又报道，另一个人B也做了不好的事。
sentences.traditional: 突然有一天，電視臺又報道，另一個人B也做了不好的事。
sentences.pinyin: tū rán yǒu yì tiān diàn shì tái yòu bào dào lìng yī ge rén bī yě zuò le bù hǎo de shì
sentences.english: Suddenly one day, the television station reports that another person, B, also did something bad.

sentences.simplified: 大家看到这些报道，就说B太坏了。
sentences.traditional: 大家看到這些報道，就說B太壞了。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā kàn dào zhè xiē bào dào jiù shuō bī tài huài le
sentences.english: Everyone who sees these reports will say that B is really terrible.

sentences.simplified: 慢慢地，报道A的新闻没有了，大家都在看B的新闻，都说B是坏人。
sentences.traditional: 慢慢地，報道A的新聞沒有了，大家都在看B的新聞，都說B是壞人。
sentences.pinyin: màn man de bào dào a de xīn wén méi yǒu le dà jiā dōu zài kàn bī de xīn wén dōu shuō bī shì huài rén
sentences.english: Gradually, the news about A disappears, and everyone starts watching the news about B, saying that B is a bad person.

sentences.simplified: 你可能已经想到了，B的坏新闻是A告诉给电视台的。
sentences.traditional: 你可能已經想到了，B的壞新聞是A告訴給電視臺的。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ kě néng yǐ jīng xiǎng dào le bī de huài xīn wén shì a gào su gěi diàn shì tái de
sentences.english: You might have already guessed that the bad news story about B was provided to the television station by A.

sentences.simplified: 没错，这就是A的“围魏救赵”。
sentences.traditional: 沒錯，這就是A的“圍魏救趙”。
sentences.pinyin: méi cuò zhè jiù shì a de wéi wèi jiù zhào
sentences.english: That’s right. This is A’s “besieging Wei to save Zhao”.

sentence_translations: “Besiege Wei to save Zhao” is the second of the Thirty-Six Stratagems.
There’s an old story in China where the state of Wei attacked the state of Zhao.
Since Zhao couldn’t defeat Wei, they asked another state, Qi, for help.
To save the state of Zhao, the state of Qi attacked the capital of the state of Wei.
Wei had no choice but to order the troops attacking Zhao to stop and immediately return to protect the capital.
In this way, the state of Qi saved the state of Zhao. This is the story of “besieging Wei to save Zhao”.
In this story, Jin Meimei caused Little Jing to crash into the police car. This was “besieging Wei”.
Between saving the injured person and arresting Zhang Xuehai, the police could only save the injured person.
They couldn’t arrest Zhang Xuehai. This was “saving Zhao”.
In our work, sometimes we encounter some bad situations.
When we don’t know what to do, we can try to approach the problem from another perspective.
Today, there are also “besieging Wei to save Zhao” situations.
For example, if A does some bad things and the television station reports on it every day, everyone will say that A is really terrible.
Suddenly one day, the television station reports that another person, B, also did something bad.
Everyone who sees these reports will say that B is really terrible.
Gradually, the news about A disappears, and everyone starts watching the news about B, saying that B is a bad person.
You might have already guessed that the bad news story about B was provided to the television station by A.
That’s right. This is A’s “besieging Wei to save Zhao”.
